column1:
Balance sheet strengthening through
repayment of all long- term debt obligations at
Centum level and enhancement of liquidity
Double the book-value of shareholders’ funds
to Ksh 100 billion by FY24

Generate a minimum return on equity of 20%
through value- creating activities.

Optimise dividend pay-out to the higher of
30% of cash annuity income (excluding capital
gains) and the previous year’s dividend pay-
out.

Maintain a maximum
operating cost-to-cash annuity income ratio of
30%.

Ensure optimisation of Centum’s operating
model to support effective and efficient
execution of its strategy including governance,
structure, people, processes, technology and
culture

Restructure portfolio to focus on three key
business units, namely:
Real Estate (Target asset allocation: 45-55%)
Private Equity (Target asset allocation: 30-40%)
Marketable Securities (Target asset allocation:
10-20%)
